relationships.subject: VX-150
relationships.evidence_quote: The active metabolite form of VX-150 (VX-150m) inhibited human Nav1.8 channels with an IC<sub>50</sub> of 15 nM.

relationships.subject: VX-548
relationships.evidence_quote: VX-548 (suzetrigine) was even more potent (IC<sub>50</sub> 0.27 nM).

key_findings: VX-150m and VX-548 inhibit human Nav1.8 with IC50 of 15 nM and 0.27 nM, respectively.
Both show reverse use-dependence: inhibition is relieved by depolarization, with very tight binding to resting-state voltage sensors.
